name: Eiko
source:
Alternate version of Erika that replaces her if you use a proper cheat.

She is Nishi's sister, but other than that she is very similar to Erika in both looks and personality.

[spoiler] Just like Erika she works part-time in a maid cafe.

Eiko apparently lost her virginity to a classmate two years ago [/spoiler]
